question.worked_solution:
First, we multiply both sides by $\color{blue}4$ to get rid of the fraction:

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{4}x & =12 \\ 4\cdot (-\frac{3}{4}x) & =4\cdot 12 \\ \cancel{4}\cdot (-\frac{3}{\cancel{4}}x) & =48 \\ -3x & =48\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we divide both sides of the equation by ${\color{red}-3}$ to isolate $x\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}-3x & =48 \\ \frac{-3x}{-3} & =\frac{48}{-3} \\ \frac{\cancel{-3}x}{\cancel{-3}} & =-16 \\ x & =-16\end{aligned}
$$
